agyos_skill.instructions: The **list/roundup content type** — right-size the premise, assemble honestly, nail every entry, keep the scroll moving, then spread it. The **format writers** turn it into cuts, **WoopSocial publishes**, and "best of" lists get engineered for AI citation. The listicle is dismissed as lazy — and most are, because they're **padded** ("25 tools" with 17 of them filler) or **self-serving** ("best X, and we're #1"). But the honestly-ranked, specific list is one of the highest-leverage assets you can make: maximally scannable, endlessly atomizable, and **disproportionately cited by AI search** — the ranked "best-of" is repeatedly the single most-cited format in AI answers. Two top-1% moves separate real lists from slop. First, **the count follows the genuinely-good items** — a tight, honest "7 worth it" beats a padded 25, because the weakest entry sets the perceived quality of the whole. Second — the counter-intuition — **the independent list compounds; the self-#1 list gets penalized.** The "best of" that earns citations is the one where you're judged alongside competitors against stated criteria; the higher-leverage play is earning a placement in someone else's honest list. Curate ruthlessly, rank honestly, make every entry a real payload. 1. **brand-profile** — what you can credibly curate/rank, and any affiliate/own-product to disclose. 2. **audience-research** — the lists they actually search for and the criteria they care about. (Depth: `references/the-ranks-framework.md`.) - **R — Right-size the premise:** a list people want, number serving the content (never padded); a title that states the payoff (number + promise + who it's for). - **A — Assemble honestly:** real, vetted items ranked by stated criteria; **no fabricated items/quotes/rankings**; disclose affiliate/sponsor/own-product; don't auto-#1 yourself; roundups need real contributors + consent. - **N — Nail every entry:** what + why-it-matters + one specific detail (outcome-anchored, "Best For" tag, named entity); cut filler — the weakest entry sets the bar. - **K — Keep the scroll moving:** lead with the best/most-surprising; front-load the hook; ruthless scannability; consistent per-entry structure. - **S — Spread + atomize:** whole list → carousel/thread, 1 item = 1 post, top 3 → video; roundup contributors
